notices.agenda_text:
EAGLE MOUNTAIN CITY COUNCIL
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARINGS


The Eagle Mountain City Council will hold public hearings on November 17, 2026, at 7:00 PM or as soon thereafter as business allows, in the Eagle Mountain City Council Chambers, 1650 E Stagecoach Run, Eagle Mountain, Utah 84005.  The City Council will receive public comments concerning the following items:

Amendment to Eagle Mountain Municipal Code: 

-	EMMC 16.65.080 Greenhouse/Farm Products Home Business: Consideration of an amendment to EMMC 17.65.080 to establish standards for home businesses to sell farm and other closely related products. 
EMC Point of Contact: Steven Lehmitz: slehmitz@eaglemountain.gov. 

-	EMMC 17.20  Public/Private Utilities in the Agricultural Zone: Consideration of an amendment to EMMC 17.20 related to Public/Private Utilities in the Agricultural Zone, including electrical transmission lines.
EMC Point of Contact: Brandon Larsen: blarsen@eaglemountain.gov. 

THE PUBLIC IS INVITED TO PARTICIPATE IN ALL CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS.

Materials for public hearing items may be viewed within three days of the meeting on the city website and at the Eagle Mountain City Recorder's Office, 1650 E Stagecoach Run, Eagle Mountain, UT, during normal business hours, Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM. If you need special accommodation to participate in the meeting, please call the City Recorder's Office at 801.789.6611.  Open portions of the meeting can be viewed at www.eaglemountain.gov. 

Certificate of Posting
The undersigned, duly appointed City Recorder, does hereby certify that the above public hearing notice was posted on this 6 day of November, 2026, on the Eagle Mountain City bulletin boards, the Eagle Mountain City website, www.eaglemountain.gov, and posted to the Utah State public notice website http://www.utah.gov/pmn/index.html.

Lacie A. Messerly, City Recorder

EAGLE MOUNTAIN
CITY COUNCIL MEETING

NOVEMBER 17, 2026, 4:00 PM
EAGLE MOUNTAIN CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS
1650 E STAGECOACH RUN, EAGLE MOUNTAIN, UT 84005


4:00 PM WORK SESSION - CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS

1.	DISCUSSION AND INFORMATION ITEMS
	This is an opportunity to provide information to the City Council. These items are for information only and do not require action by the City Council.

	1.A.	DISCUSSION - Quarterly Budget Report - Budget Manager Terrence Dela Peña
(anticipated time 15 minutes)

	1.B.	DISCUSSION - Airport Feasibility Study Results
(anticipated time 1 hour)

2.	CITY MANAGER INFORMATION ITEMS
	This is an opportunity for the City Manager to provide information to the City Council. 

3.	AGENDA REVIEW
	The City Council will review items on the Consent Agenda and Policy Session Agenda.

4.	ADJOURN TO A CLOSED SESSION
	The City Council will adjourn into a Closed Session for the purpose of discussion of pending or reasonably imminent litigation; the character, professional competence, or physical or mental health of an individual; the purchase, lease, sale, or exchange of real property; a proposed development agreement, project proposal, or financing proposal related to the development of land owned by the state or a political subdivision; and/or the deployment of security personnel, devices, or systems, pursuant to Section 52-4-205(1) of the Utah Code, Annotated.

7:00 PM POLICY SESSION - CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS

5.	CALL TO ORDER

6.	PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

7.	INFORMATION ITEMS/UPCOMING EVENTS

8.	PUBLIC COMMENTS
	Time has been set aside for the public to express their ideas, concerns, and comments. (Please limit your comments to three minutes each.)

9.	CITY COUNCIL/MAYOR ITEMS
	Time has been set aside for the City Council and Mayor to make comments.

CONSENT AGENDA

10.	BOND RELEASES

	10.A.	The District at Eagle Mountain Town Center - Out of Warranty 

11.	CHANGE ORDERS

	11.A.	CHANGE ORDER - Trailhead & Pony Express Signal (Median Removal) - Change Order #4

12.	MINUTES

	12.A.	October 28, 2026 Minutes - Special City Council Meeting - Joint Work Session

	12.B.	November 4, Minutes - Regular City Council Meeting

13.	RESOLUTIONS

	13.A.	RESOLUTION - A Resolution Of The City Council (The 'Council') Of Eagle Mountain, Utah (The 'City'), Ratifying The Use Of A Preliminary Official Statement And Authorizing An Official Statement In Connection With The Issuance And Sale Of The Sales Tax And Tax Increment Revenue Bonds, Series 2026 Of The Redevelopment Agency Of Eagle Mountain City (The 'Agency'); And Authorizing The Taking Of All Other Actions Necessary To The Consummation Of The Transactions Contemplated By This Resolution; And Related Matters

	13.B.	RESOLUTION - A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Awarding the Bid for the EMC Work Authorization GMP 3 BNR & MTB Structural Package to MGC Contractors, Inc and Authorizing the Mayor to Execute the Work Authorization Agreement

SCHEDULED ITEMS

14.	HONORING TODD A. BLACK

	14.A.	RECOGNITION - Announcement of the Todd A. Black Memorial Scholarship at Utah State University

BACKGROUND: (Presented by Bayley Hedglin) In honor of Todd A. Black's service as Eagle Mountain City's Wildlife Biologist and his dedication to wildlife conservation, the Todd A. Black Memorial Scholarship has been established at Utah State University. The scholarship will support students pursuing studies in wildlife biology/natural resources, continuing Todd's legacy and his commitment to protecting the natural environment.


	14.B.	RESOLUTION - A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Designating the Wildlife Corridor as the Todd A. Black Memorial Wildlife Corridor in Honor of Todd A. Black and his Contributions to the Wildlife Conservation

BACKGROUND: (Presented by Community Development Director, Brandon Larsen) Todd A. Black served as Eagle Mountain City's Wildlife Biologist and made a lasting contribution to the community. In recognition of his service and in honor of his memory, the proposed resolution designates the Wildlife Corridor as the Todd A. Black Memorial Wildlife Corridor. This designation provides a lasting tribute to Todd and his connection to Eagle Mountain City.

15.	RESOLUTIONS

	15.A.	RESOLUTION - A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving a Three-Year Extension to the Valley Crossroad Chamber of Commerce Ladder Sign Concession Agreement

BACKGROUND: (Presented by City Attorney Marcus Draper) In February 2023, the City entered into a Ladder Sign Concession Agreement with the Eagle Mountain Chamber of Commerce, now the Valley Crossroads Chamber of Commerce, to administer the City's ladder sign program. Section 2.03 of the Agreement allows the term to be extended by mutual agreement for one additional three-year period.

16.	ORDINANCES/PUBLIC HEARINGS

	16.A.	ORDINANCE/PUBLIC HEARING - An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapter 17.20 Agricultural Zone

BACKGROUND: (Presented by Community Development Director, Brandon Larsen) The proposed code amends Eagle Mountain Municipal Cose to make public and private utilities, including electrical transmission lines, either a special or permitted use in the Agricultural Zone.

	16.B.	ORDINANCE/PUBLIC HEARING - An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code 17.65.080 Greenhouse/Farm Products Home Business

BACKGROUND: (Presented by Planning Manager, Steven Lehmitz) The proposed code amends Eagle Mountain Municipal Code 17.65.080 to establish standards for home businesses to sell farm and other closely related products.

17.	ORDINANCES

	17.A.	ORDINANCE - An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 17.60.120 General Fencing/Screening Provisions

BACKGROUND: (Presented by Senior Planner, Robert Hobbs) The proposed amendment would allow barbed wire fencing in the RTI Overlay Zone and clarify that chain link fencing, where permitted in industrial areas, shall not be topped with barbed wire as it would only be allowed for the RTI Zone. This item was tabled at the October 6 City Council meeting.

18.	LEGISLATIVE ITEMS

	18.A.	UPDATE - Legislative Priorities List

19.	CITY COUNCIL/MAYOR'S BUSINESS AND LIAISON REPORTS
	This time is set aside for the City Council's and Mayor's comments on City business, and for Councilmembers to report on the boards they are assigned to as liaisons to the City Council. 

20.	COMMUNICATION ITEMS

	20.A.	Upcoming Agenda Items

21.	ADJOURNMENT

THE PUBLIC IS INVITED TO PARTICIPATE IN PUBLIC MEETINGS FOR ALL AGENDAS.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, Eagle Mountain City will make reasonable accommodations for participation in all Public Meetings and Work Sessions. Please call the City Recorder's Office at least 3 working days prior to the meeting at 801-789-6611. This meeting may be held telephonically to allow a member of the public body to participate. This agenda is subject to change with a minimum 24-hour notice.

CERTIFICATE OF POSTING

The undersigned, duly appointed City Recorder, does hereby certify that the above agenda notice was posted on this 12 day of November, 2026, on the Eagle Mountain City bulletin boards, the Eagle Mountain City website www.eaglemountain.gov, and posted to the Utah State public notice website http://www.utah.gov/pmn/index.html.

Lacie Messerly
City Recorder
